<div class="card-body">
'''Proton Torpedoes''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">プロトン魚雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、Ｘウイング、Ｙウイング、Ｂウイングのいずれかに配備する。１フォース使用して起動する。運命数を引くこと。大型艦の場合、運命数＞装甲値で命中。宇宙戦闘機の場合、運命数＞回避値で命中。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-158o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">強力無比な弾道弾。陽子を放出するエネルギー弾頭を搭載。射程距離は短い。エネルギー・シールドを貫くが、粒子シールドには防がれる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Proton Torpedoes.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on an X-wing, Y-wing, or B-wing. Use 1 Force to fire and draw destiny. A capital ship is hit if destiny exceeds armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny exceeds maneuver.

'''Lore:''' An exceptionally powerful projectile with a proton-emitting energy warhead. It has a short range. It penetrates energy shields, but particle shields stop it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spends 1 Force to fire; the English may target using 1 Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Proton Torpedoes]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
